metadata.description:
In Segra’s Audio Merge screen, check the numbered File order list before choosing Merge and save.

Still-screen guide using a real Android native capture with repository-authored demonstration filenames. No file selection, reordering, playback, merging, saved result, or speed demonstration is shown. The sample files are capture fixtures, not music recordings.
